scene.title: Verify the reading
scene.question: Does an unreliable measurement lead to instrument verification?

alerts.evidence: vibration velocity 0.89 mm/s above the value expected for this operating point (z=+16.0). Context: demand 90 %, supply water 8.9 degC. Vibration snapshot: 1x 1.18 mm/s, 2x 1.32 mm/s (2x dominant: typical of misalignment).
alerts.recommended_action: Check shaft alignment and coupling condition (laser alignment), especially after recent maintenance.

alerts.evidence: motor current deviates alone: +3.97 A from the context-expected value (z=+4.5); the physically coupled channels do not show the change a real machine fault would cause. Pattern: gradual ramp.
alerts.recommended_action: Verify the motor current transmitter against a portable reference gauge and recalibrate; do not act on the machine based on this channel until verified.
